claims.text: Rowboat positions itself as a local-first AI coworker that stores long-lived working memory as Obsidian-compatible Markdown notes on the user's machine.
Rowboat's Electron app exposes typed agent definitions with built-in, MCP, and agent-as-tool attachments, plus scheduled agent entries for cron/window/once runs.
Rowboat's run runtime has a run log/lock/abort flow, emits permission and ask-human events, supports agent subflows, and limits each LLM step to one step before processing tool calls.

Rowboat Live Notes implement a concrete note-agent pattern: one objective in frontmatter, backend-only writes for live metadata, 15s timed scheduler, 5min backoff, per-note concurrency guard, event queue, FIFO event processing, and two-pass event routing.

Rowboat includes local tool surfaces and external integrations that are useful references but are not safe to wholesale import into Hermes without sandbox/permission/proof review: shell command execution, MCP clients, Composio/API-key integrations, and OAuth/service integrations.

evidence.quote: Open-source AI coworker... local-first... maintains an Obsidian-compatible vault of plain Markdown notes... everything lives on your machine as plain Markdown.
ToolAttachment is a discriminated union of builtin, mcp, and agent; Agent has name/provider/model/description/instructions/tools.
AgentRuntime.trigger locks a run, creates abort signal, appends/broadcasts events, cleans abort registry and releases lock; runs.ts creates runs/messages and stop() aborts.
ask-human calls wait; blocked executeCommand emits tool-permission-request; agent tools spawn subflows; permission responses resume runtime and optional always approval persists command names.
One live: frontmatter block with objective/triggers/runtime fields; renderer never writes live key; scheduler/event processor/runLiveNoteAgent; per-note serialization.
POLL_INTERVAL_MS=15_000; scans knowledge markdown; skips inactive; checks dueTimedTrigger and backoffRemainingMs; fires runLiveNoteAgent asynchronously.
runningLiveNotes Set concurrency guard; lastAttemptAt/lastRunId before execution; lastRunAt only on success; failure records lastRunError; cleanup in finally.
events/pending and done JSON dirs; monotonic ID filenames; malformed events moved to done with error; filenames sorted; candidates processed sequentially and enriched.
Routing classifier is liberal and prefers false positives; targetFilePath short-circuits; batches of 20 generate Pass1OutputSchema filePaths.
Optional Deepgram/ElevenLabs/Exa/Composio API keys; MCP external tools; examples include search, databases, CRMs, support tools, automations.
isBlocked uses allowlist/session allowed commands; executeCommand runs arbitrary shell through exec; abortable execution uses spawn shell with process group.
MCP config supports stdio command/args/env and remote URL transports; executeTool calls client.callTool.

recommendations.title: Event queue + proofed pending/done ledger for taskpool signals
recommendations.why: Rowboat's pending/done event queue and malformed-event quarantine map well to Hermes taskpool watcher events without importing runtime.
recommendations.next_slice: Design a local-brain event artifact schema with source/type/payload/processedAt/error/proof_hash, read-only processor first.

recommendations.title: Single-objective live task note envelope
recommendations.why: Rowboat's one objective + triggers + runtime fields is a clean control-plane invariant; Hermes already has mission envelopes and can add a lightweight validator/audit for objective/triggers/runtime separation.
recommendations.next_slice: Compare existing mission_envelope fields with live objective/triggers fields and add a schema-diff note before any validator patch.

recommendations.title: Liberal pass-1 routing + executor veto for multimodel/taskpool intervention
recommendations.why: This addresses Hermes keyword false-positive pressure: route broadly, but require executor/task verifier veto before mutation.
recommendations.next_slice: Prototype offline classifier against current taskpool trigger logs; no write surface.

recommendations.title: Do not import Rowboat runtime/Electron/Composio/MCP stack wholesale
recommendations.why: It overlaps with Hermes gateway/cron/memory/tooling, adds external key/tool surfaces, and lacks Hermes proof-chain/ratification gates by default.
recommendations.next_slice: Clean-room documentation only; no dependency or code copy.
